package observer_test

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/baselineobservation"
	platformhttpserver "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/httpserver"
	platformprocess "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/process"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/root"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/edges"
	sessions "github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/factory_sessions"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/work"
)

type smokeObserver struct {
	artifact      artifactIdentity
	sessionID     string
	bootstrap     []string
	generations   []string
	runtimeID     string
	reports       []checkpointReport
	barrier       string
	complete      bool
	cleanupErrors []string
}

// This dedicated diagnostic is sequential: process-wide goroutines and retained
// owner callbacks require one isolated observation window, not functional lanes.
func TestInProcessOwnerLifecycleSmoke(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("explicit owner lifecycle diagnostic only")
	}
	observer := &smokeObserver{artifact: smokeArtifact(t), barrier: "construction"}
	baselineobservation.Close()
	defer baselineobservation.Close()
	defer observer.emit(t)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	home, folder := t.TempDir(), smokeFactory(t)
	ready := make(chan struct{})
	process, err := root.BuildProcess(ctx, edges.Edges{
		FactorySessionIDGenerator: uuid.NewString,
		BrowserOpener:             func(context.Context, string) error { return nil },
		ProviderCommandRunner:     smokeCommandRunner{},
		APIServerStarter: func(ctx context.Context, req platformhttpserver.StartRequest) error {
			server := httptest.NewServer(req.Handler)
			if req.OnBound != nil {
				req.OnBound(platformhttpserver.Binding{Port: req.Port})
			}
			close(ready)
			<-ctx.Done()
			server.CloseClientConnections()
			server.Close()
			return nil
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	service, ok := process.FactorySessions().FactorySessions().(sessions.Service)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("public Factory Sessions capability unavailable")
	}
	defer func() {
		cleanup, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer stop()
		if err := process.Close(cleanup); err != nil {
			observer.cleanupErrors = append(observer.cleanupErrors, err.Error())
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	observer.capture(t, "Q0", "inert BuildProcess returned; no admission")
	hostCtx, stopHost := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		done <- process.Execute(root.Input{
			Args: []string{"you", "run", "--factory", filepath.Join(folder, "factory.json"), "--continuously", "--with-server", "--quiet", "--no-record"},
			Env:  []string{"HOME=" + home, "USERPROFILE=" + home}, Context: hostCtx, WorkingDirectory: folder, Stdout: io.Discard, Stderr: io.Discard,
		})
	}()
	joined := false
	defer func() {
		if !joined {
			stopHost()
			observer.join(t, done)
		}
	}()
	observer.barrier = "host transport readiness"
	select {
	case <-ready:
	case err := <-done:
		joined = true
		t.Fatalf("host exited before readiness: %v", err)
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	observer.lifecycle(t, ctx, service, home, folder)
	stopHost()
	observer.barrier = "Process.Execute/server/sidecar join"
	if !observer.join(t, done) {
		joined = true
		t.Fatal("host cleanup did not join successfully")
	}
	joined = true
	observer.barrier = "process cleanup"
	if err := process.Close(ctx); err != nil {
		observer.cleanupErrors = append(observer.cleanupErrors, err.Error())
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	observer.capture(t, "Q2", "explicit close returned; Execute and server joined; Process.Close returned")
	observer.complete = !t.Failed()
}

func (observer *smokeObserver) lifecycle(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, service sessions.Service, home, folder string) {
	observer.barrier = "bootstrap inventory"
	listed, err := service.List(ctx, sessions.SessionListRequest{Mode: sessions.SessionOperationModeLive})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, session := range listed.Sessions {
		observer.bootstrap = append(observer.bootstrap, session.SessionID)
	}
	observer.sessionID = uuid.NewString()
	request := sessions.SessionStartRequest{SessionID: observer.sessionID, Mode: sessions.SessionOperationModeLive, FolderPath: folder, ActivationOnly: true,
		Correlation:      sessions.SessionOperationCorrelation{RequestID: "observer-open"},
		RuntimeSelection: &sessions.SessionRuntimeSelection{Mode: sessions.SessionRuntimeModeService, SystemConfigHome: home, RuntimeInstanceID: uuid.NewString()},
	}
	observer.barrier = "explicit session open"
	opened, err := service.Start(ctx, request)
	if err != nil || opened.SessionID != observer.sessionID {
		t.Fatalf("open: %#v %v", opened, err)
	}
	defer func() {
		cleanup, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer stop()
		if _, err := service.Control(cleanup, sessions.SessionControlRequest{SessionID: observer.sessionID, Mode: sessions.SessionOperationModeLive, Operation: sessions.SessionControlClose}); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, sessions.ErrSessionNotFound) {
			observer.cleanupErrors = append(observer.cleanupErrors, err.Error())
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	prior := observer.generation(t, ctx, service)
	observer.invoke(t, ctx, service, "observer-before-replace")
	observer.barrier = "cancel before terminal replacement"
	canceled, err := service.Control(ctx, sessions.SessionControlRequest{SessionID: observer.sessionID, Mode: sessions.SessionOperationModeLive, Operation: sessions.SessionControlCancel, Correlation: sessions.SessionOperationCorrelation{RequestID: "observer-cancel"}})
	if err != nil || canceled.Status != sessions.LifecycleStatusSucceeded {
		t.Fatalf("cancel: %#v %v", canceled, err)
	}
	observer.barrier = "terminal replacement commit and prior cleanup"
	request.Correlation.RequestID = "observer-replace"
	request.RuntimeSelection.RuntimeInstanceID = uuid.NewString()
	replaced, err := service.Start(ctx, request)
	if err != nil || replaced.SessionID != observer.sessionID {
		t.Fatalf("replace: %#v %v", replaced, err)
	}
	current := observer.generation(t, ctx, service)
	if current == prior {
		t.Fatal("replacement did not advance runtime generation")
	}
	observer.generations = []string{current}
	observer.runtimeID = request.RuntimeSelection.RuntimeInstanceID
	if !strings.HasPrefix(current, observer.runtimeID+"-") {
		t.Fatalf("generation %q does not attribute runtime %q", current, observer.runtimeID)
	}
	observer.invoke(t, ctx, service, "observer-after-replace")
	observer.capture(t, "Q1", "replacement Start returned after prior close; replacement Work Invoke returned terminal")
	observer.barrier = "explicit session close"
	closed, err := service.Control(ctx, sessions.SessionControlRequest{SessionID: observer.sessionID, Mode: sessions.SessionOperationModeLive, Operation: sessions.SessionControlClose})
	if err != nil || !closed.Closed {
		t.Fatalf("close: %#v %v", closed, err)
	}
}

func (observer *smokeObserver) generation(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, service sessions.Service) string {
	projection, err := service.GetFactorySession(ctx, observer.sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if projection.Runtime.StreamIdentity == nil || projection.Runtime.StreamIdentity.StreamGenerationID == "" {
		t.Fatal("runtime generation unavailable")
	}
	return projection.Runtime.StreamIdentity.StreamGenerationID
}

func (observer *smokeObserver) invoke(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, service sessions.Service, id string) {
	observer.barrier = "Work terminal acknowledgment: " + id
	result, err := service.Invoke(ctx, sessions.SessionInvokeRequest{SessionID: observer.sessionID, Correlation: sessions.SessionOperationCorrelation{RequestID: id},
		Input: &work.PreparedInvocationInput{Source: work.InputSourcePositionalText, ResolvedInput: &work.ResolvedInput{Source: work.InputSourcePositionalText, Text: id}},
		Wait:  sessions.SessionOperationWait{TimeoutMillis: 30000},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.RequestID != id || result.Status != sessions.InvocationTerminalStatusCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("invocation completion: %#v", result)
	}
	t.Logf("Work terminal outcome: %#v", result)
}

func (observer *smokeObserver) join(t *testing.T, done <-chan error) bool {
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			observer.cleanupErrors = append(observer.cleanupErrors, err.Error())
			t.Error(err)
			return false
		}
		return true
	case <-time.After(30 * time.Second):
		observer.cleanupErrors = append(observer.cleanupErrors, "Execute/server join ceiling reached")
		t.Error("Execute/server join ceiling reached")
		return false
	}
}

func (observer *smokeObserver) capture(t *testing.T, checkpoint, barrier string) {
	observer.barrier = checkpoint + " owner capture"
	owners, err := baselineobservation.Capture()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if checkpoint == "Q1" {
		matches := 0
		for _, owner := range owners {
			if owner.Host != nil {
				for _, handle := range owner.Host.Handles {
					if handle.Key == observer.runtimeID {
						matches++
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if matches != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("current replacement runtime %q has %d real handle entries", observer.runtimeID, matches)
		}
	}
	report := checkpointReport{Checkpoint: checkpoint, Timestamp: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), FixtureScope: "one root process; controlled Codex; no model/remote effects", Artifact: observer.artifact,
		Owners: owners, OwnerInventoryComplete: true, LiveGoroutines: runtime.NumGoroutine(), Barriers: []string{barrier}, RuntimeGenerationIDs: append([]string{}, observer.generations...), BootstrapSessionIDs: append([]string{}, observer.bootstrap...),
		Findings: []string{"controlled Models activity only; RQ-2-COMPOSED-CAPACITY, T27/T22-P01, I01 and VAL01 unproven"},
	}
	if observer.sessionID != "" {
		report.FactorySessionID = &observer.sessionID
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"instance_host", "models_leases"} {
		discovery := ownerDiscovery{Kind: kind, Status: "registered", Provenance: "actual instrumented constructors; retained through process cleanup"}
		for _, owner := range owners {
			if owner.Kind == kind {
				discovery.OwnerIdentities = append(discovery.OwnerIdentities, owner.OwnerIdentity)
			}
			totals, err := validateOwner(owner)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if owner.Kind == kind {
				report.Totals.HandleCount += totals.HandleCount
				report.Totals.LeaseRecordCount += totals.LeaseRecordCount
				report.Totals.CapacityHoldersTotal += totals.CapacityHoldersTotal
			}
		}
		report.OwnerDiscovery = append(report.OwnerDiscovery, discovery)
	}
	if err := validateReport(report); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	observer.reports = append(observer.reports, report)
}

func (observer *smokeObserver) emit(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := json.MarshalIndent(struct {
		Complete      bool               `json:"complete"`
		Barrier       string             `json:"lastBarrier"`
		CleanupErrors []string           `json:"cleanupErrors"`
		Checkpoints   []checkpointReport `json:"checkpoints"`
	}{observer.complete && !t.Failed() && len(observer.cleanupErrors) == 0, observer.barrier, observer.cleanupErrors, observer.reports}, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
		return
	}
	t.Log(string(payload))
	if path := os.Getenv("OBSERVER_REPORT"); path != "" {
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, payload, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}
}

func smokeArtifact(t *testing.T) artifactIdentity {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("OBSERVER_MANIFEST"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var manifest struct{ SourceCommit, ToolSourceCommit, GoVersion, BuildCommand string }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &manifest); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
	artifact := artifactIdentity{SourceCommit: manifest.SourceCommit, ToolSourceCommit: manifest.ToolSourceCommit, GoVersion: manifest.GoVersion, BuildCommand: manifest.BuildCommand, OverlayManifestSHA256: hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), TestArtifactSHA256: os.Getenv("OBSERVER_ARTIFACT_SHA256")}
	if artifact.TestArtifactSHA256 == "" {
		t.Fatal("prebuilt artifact SHA256 required")
	}
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bytes, err := os.ReadFile(executable)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	executableHash := sha256.Sum256(bytes)
	if hex.EncodeToString(executableHash[:]) != artifact.TestArtifactSHA256 {
		t.Fatal("running test artifact does not match declared SHA256")
	}
	return artifact
}

func smokeFactory(t *testing.T) string {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	config := `{"name":"owner-observer","workTypes":[{"name":"task","handlingBehavior":["DEFAULT"],"states":[{"name":"init","type":"INITIAL"},{"name":"complete","type":"TERMINAL"},{"name":"failed","type":"FAILED"}]}],"workers":[{"name":"worker-a"}],"workstations":[{"name":"process","worker":"worker-a","inputs":[{"workType":"task","state":"init"}],"outputs":[{"workType":"task","state":"complete"}],"onFailure":[{"workType":"task","state":"failed"}]}]}`
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "factory.json"), []byte(config), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	worker := filepath.Join(dir, "workers", "worker-a")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(worker, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(worker, "AGENTS.md"), []byte("---\ntype: MODEL_WORKER\nmodel: gpt-5-codex\nmodelProvider: codex\nstopToken: COMPLETE\n---\nProcess the input task.\n"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return dir
}

type smokeCommandRunner struct{}

func (smokeCommandRunner) Run(_ context.Context, req platformprocess.CommandRequest) (platformprocess.CommandResult, error) {
	if req.Command != "codex" {
		return platformprocess.CommandResult{}, fmt.Errorf("unexpected external command: %q", req.Command)
	}
	return platformprocess.CommandResult{Stdout: []byte("{\"type\":\"turn.started\"}\n{\"type\":\"item.completed\",\"item\":{\"id\":\"observer\",\"type\":\"agent_message\",\"text\":\"Observed. COMPLETE\"}}\n{\"type\":\"turn.completed\",\"usage\":{\"input_tokens\":1,\"output_tokens\":1}}\n")}, nil
}
